description: Derived input-to-output price spreads computed from the latest stored Magpie prices: corn-to-nitrogen cost broken down per fertilizer product (bushels of corn per ton of product and per pound of actual N), the soybean-to-corn price ratio, and the feeder-to-fed cattle spread. Use for planting and feeding economics; use the raw price tools (get_grain_price, get_fertilizer_price, get_livestock_price) instead for the quotes behind a spread. Read-only; no API key. These are Magpie calculations over stored USDA MARS prices, not USDA-published figures; a spread is omitted when either side has no stored price. Geography defaults to IL and applies to both sides of each spread.

geography.description: State/region code used for both sides of the spreads (e.g. IL, IA). Default: IL

name: get_spreads
